name: ChatICD-Bench
description: ChatICD-Bench evaluates models on clinical diagnostic coding (ICD) tasks, measuring the ability to map clinical case descriptions to appropriate ICD codes and provide diagnostic reasoning. It focuses on medical language understanding, multi-label coding, and clinical decision support in a medical context. The benchmark is intended for assessing safety-critical and domain-expert performance of language models in healthcare.
reputation: Niche but relevant within clinical NLP and medical AI communities; moderate interest from researchers working on clinical coding and diagnostics.
